description: Make a map public or private at its current revision. Obtain the user's explicit permission to publish and confirmation that they have the right to publish before setting copyright_acknowledged=true; never infer it from map content. Initial publication creates a moderated public snapshot and generated preview. Making private removes the snapshot and disables live viewing. Setting an already-public map public does not publish edits: use publish_knowmapped_map. Reuse the same idempotency_key and identical arguments after a dropped response; a different request needs a new key. A pending_review result means publication has not succeeded. On a revision conflict, retrieve the map and reconsider before retrying.
name: set_knowmapped_map_visibility
title: Set KnowMapped map visibility
